main.description: One card on an account's unset.sh profile page. It is shown only on a page (sh.unset.page) whose cards list names it, in that order, and a block with nothing to show (an empty list, for example) is hidden. Readers apply that page's visibility to it.

content.description: What the card holds: one of the sh.unset.block types. Other apps may add their own types; readers hide types they do not know.

width.description: Width on wide screens. Absent or unknown means full.

surface.description: How the card's outer surface is drawn. Absent or unknown means filled.

createdAt.description: When the card was first created.
